corrected.why: The port states the URL and the status itself. Python's message is httpx's, which carries the reason phrase, an MDN link and the httpx version that phrased it; pinning the corpus to that text would redden this case on an httpx upgrade. The exception *name*, the failure and the records kept are identical. Recorded in the plan's §9.
